title: Boss: the cleanup
brief:
Boss level. `feature` has four commits of chaos: "wip: export", "debug junk", "more export work", "fix export edge case". Meanwhile main moved one commit ahead. This branch is ready to ship when it is ONE commit called "add export feature", sitting on top of main, containing the final export.txt and none of the debug junk.

Everything you need is already unlocked: `git rebase -i main`, the worksheet verbs (`reword <sha> <new message>` renames inline), and `--continue`.

One rebase. No merge commit. Four commands or fewer.

goals.label: feature is one commit on top of main's two

args:
add export feature

more export work

fix export edge case
goals.label: One commit, renamed, with the squashed story preserved
main's work came along (rebased onto it)

hints: git rebase -i main. The worksheet is oldest-first: wip, debug, more, fix.
reword the first line to 'add export feature', drop the debug line, squash the other two.
git rebase --continue runs the plan. If a squash conflicts, resolve, git add, --continue again.
